payload.text: `bin/devbin test` WITH NO ARGUMENT PRINTS ITS USAGE AND EXITS 1; THE FULL SUITE IS `bin/devbin test all`. On 2026-10-07 a backgrounded bare `test` "completed" in under a second. Its meta's rc=1 and its one-line console showed it before anything was read as a result. A suite is read from its seal (tmp/test/<stamp>.bats.out and .errors) and from its plan line, never from a background job's exit.
